message.content:
Side-by-side vehicles (SSVs) are classified in heading 8703 as motor vehicles principally designed for the transport of persons. The engine is spark-ignition at 1,001 cc, which falls in the 1,000 cc to 1,500 cc range, so the subheading is 8703.23.

CBP rulings on the Can-Am Maverick place it in 8703.21 for engines of 1,000 cc or less and in 8703.22 or 8703.23 for larger engines. The 8703.21 subheading covers engines not exceeding 1,000 cc, so 1,001 cc moves to 8703.22, which covers engines over 1,000 cc but not over 1,500 cc. Subheading 8703.23 covers engines over 1,500 cc but not over 3,000 cc.

The correct subheading is therefore 8703.22. In the HTSUS, 8703.21 is for engines of 1,000 cc or less, 8703.22 is for engines over 1,000 cc up to 1,500 cc, and 8703.23 is for engines over 1,500 cc up to 3,000 cc.

The statistical suffix is the remaining question. HTSUS 8703.22.01 has the 10-digit line 8703.22.0100, "Vehicles specially designed for travel on snow; golf carts and similar vehicles," and 8703.22.0190 is "Other" (the 8703.22.01 line for other vehicles is 8703.22.0190). I'll go with 8703.22.0190.
